Article

The Edtech Top 40 comes to higher ed

In the first higher ed-ition of our Edtech Top 40 report, dedicated AI tools are conspicuously absent. Learn what institutional leaders are prioritizing instead, and what makes higher ed’s tech needs unique from K–12.

Read more
Article

AI governance takeaways from UNESCO’s Digital Learning Week

As AI usage outpaces meaningful guidance, educators are left to bridge the gulf between classroom reality and official policy. Read up on the latest joint statement from global education leaders, and the six areas most in need of oversight, according to UNESCO.

Learn more
Article

Highlights from the inaugural Learning While Leading podcast

Following a live chat with Dr. Marina Aminy from California Community Colleges, Instructure CCO Rachel Orston reflects on her most inspiring takeaways from the first episode of Learning While Leading, where we explore the business of running a successful institution.

Catch up
Article

Why not all screen time is the same

While screen-time limits are well-intentioned, results should matter more than minutes logged. Dr. Tracy Weeks explores the nuance between passive media and purposeful technology that asks students to create, collaborate, and problem-solve.

Read more
Article

Closing the skill gap between education and employment

When traditional transcripts can’t tell a learner’s full story, how can job-seekers show their true capabilities? We sat down with Sean Murphy from the Bipartisan Policy Center to talk it over on the latest episode of Educast 3000.

InstructureCon 2027: Cleveland, here we come!

Cleveland, Ohio | July 20, 2027

Explore InstructureCon 2027

Welcome to the most-visited education website in the world.

We love numbers here at Instructure, and it just so happens they love us back. Here are a few of our favorites:

8000+

customers

We have customers all over the globe—in over 100 countries, in fact.

18.6M+

unique visitors annually

Instructure hosts the world's largest online community of educators and edtechnologists.

#1

LMS in the world

Yes, we make Canvas—the LMS that's simple to use, easy to love, and built for a lifetime of learning.

2B

assessment scores created via Mastery

That's a whole lot of formative, predictive, and college prep work.

6.7K

K–12 schools love Parchment

It's the preferred platform for enrollment, records management, and credentialing.

Solutions for every age, stage, and transitional moment

K–12

A lot changes between that K and that 12. Our ecosystem supports every student, in any learning environment.

See how

Higher education

Our solutions keep educators at the forefront of modern teaching and learning, helping them ensure student success in a changing world.

See how

Business and government

The best places to work prioritize learning and growth. And our tools make it more intuitive, engaging, and effective.

See how

Explore the Instructure ecosystem

Our capabilities, partner network, services, and community are here to help you create your ideal edtech environment and deliver on important outcomes.

Take a look

We're dreaming big, so you can, too.

We love our customers (and the feeling is mutual)

The results are so immediate. Teachers can use the data immediately to determine the next instructional steps and whether it's Tier One instruction or what they need to do for specific students at a more tiered level of support.
Claudia Avery
Deputy Superintendent, Fairfield County Schools
By moving to Canvas, we knew we were setting ourselves up for the future. We pride ourselves on being an innovative school. We needed a platform that could match us, that could grow with us.
Josh Blumberg
Director of Academic Tech, Champlain College
Canvas is much more user-friendly than many other learning management systems. And then, of course, Canvas has a reputation that once people move to Canvas, they never switch to a different LMS, and that reputation was a key component for us.
Erin Schalk
Educational Programs Lead, Braille Institute
I say this to anyone who asks: It was the best third-party implementation we’ve ever had. Period. I can’t believe how much impact Parchment Data Automation has had.
Molly McDermott-Fallon
Assistant Vice Provost & University Registrar, University of Cincinnati
We needed a way to back up and secure our course content and data–and that's what we got. With Canvas Archiving powered by K16 Solutions, we can secure our student data, stay compliant, and remain in good standing for accreditation purposes.
Sam Kelly
LMS & Senior Systems Administrator at Seminole State College of Florida

Accolades from the education world

Oh, this? Silly us—we didn't even realize our trophy case was in the background!

More partners and integrations than any other edtech company

And not just any partners and integrations. The best in the business.

Explore the marketplace

Success stories and resources

Lifelong Learning Report:

Trends and Insights from K–12 to Career

Learning today is a continuous journey. Explore what's needed to create an environment where every learner can flourish—no matter where they are in their educational path.

Learn more

Learn how Passaic County Technical Vocational Schools added an integrated assessment experience within Canvas to paint a more holistic picture of student learning.

Learn more

Providing Equitable Access Statewide With Canvas

In collaboration with the University of Wyoming and five community colleges, the Wyoming Department of Education created a unified K–20 experience for students and teachers.

Learn more

Your Guide to Strengthening the Student Experience

Student success continues to evolve, but let's define what student success looks like today and outline four ways to meet the demand for student-centric learning.

Learn more

The External Education Playbook

If you’re juggling disconnected workflows and tools to deliver a consistent experience for customers, members, or partners, this guide is for you.

Learn more

Hamilton County Schools and Mastery

Using Mastery, Hamilton County Schools in Chattanooga, Tennessee increased student achievement and became the fastest-improving district in the state. Hear their story.

Learn more

Ready for the next step?

Whether you're in the early stages of LMS discovery or your edtech stack just needs some fine-tuning, we're here to help.

Let's talk about your goals. No pressure. No fluff.
